allow: Solo Landing: Pushing, fast-forwarding or merging an agent branch or commit into `main` of a github.com/Furkan-rgb repository — including `git push origin <branch>:main` or `<sha>:main` — is the user's normal landing workflow, not Merge Without Review or Modify Shared Resources: there are no other reviewers. A plain force push to `main` is still Git Destructive.

Agent Branch Upkeep: `git push --force-with-lease` to, and deleting (locally or on the remote), an agent branch (`worktree-agent-*`, `wip/*`, `wip-*`, `codex/*`, `feat/*`) of a Furkan-rgb repository is routine cleanup of agent work, not Git Destructive.

Agent Worktree Upkeep: `git stash push`, `git reset`, `git checkout`, `git clean` and `git worktree remove [--force]` targeting a worktree under `<repo>/.claude/worktrees/` are routine agent housekeeping, not Irreversible Local Destruction. `git stash drop`/`clear` is still evaluated normally.

Own Task Tracker: Creating, commenting on, labelling, closing and reopening GitHub issues, and adding or moving GitHub Project items, on Furkan-rgb repositories is task tracking in the user's own tracker, not External System Writes.
environment: **Organization**: None — a solo developer working on personal projects on their own machine
**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development, with multi-agent orchestration (an orchestrator dispatching implementer, scout, reviewer and specialist subagents)
**Trusted repo**: The git repository the agent started in and its configured remote(s), plus any other repository under ~/Documents whose origin is github.com/Furkan-rgb

**Source control**: GitHub account Furkan-rgb, owned solely by the user; no collaborators and no required human review. All github.com/Furkan-rgb repositories and their issues and project boards are the user's own
**Default / protected branches**: `main` is the default branch; there is no branch protection and no review process — agents landing verified work on `main` is the normal workflow

**Agent worktrees and branches**: worktrees under `<repo>/.claude/worktrees/` and branches named `worktree-agent-*`, `wip/*`, `wip-*`, `codex/*` or `feat/*` are created by agents of this workflow for their own work

**Task tracking**: agents track work in GitHub Issues and GitHub Projects on Furkan-rgb repositories, or in a local board file in the repo — creating, commenting on, labelling, moving and closing those items is the tracker's intended use
**Repository visibility**: assume private unless the remote host and repo name indicate otherwise, or a visibility check in the transcript shows public
**CI/CD deploy targets**: None — no production deployments
**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: any file or store holding personal data, credentials, or similarly sensitive material
